prompt:
You are authoring ONE new test case for an independent code-review benchmark. Invent a small, realistic, self-contained diff in go — either one with exactly one seeded defect, or a clean diff with no defect at all. If you author a defective case, prefer a defect in the "logic-error" category if you can do so naturally; do not force it if it doesn't fit your scenario.

Reply with ONLY a single JSON object, no prose before or after, matching exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "one short human-readable line",
  "language": "go",
  "affected_files": ["path/to/file.ext"],
  "diff": ["--- a/path/to/file.ext", "+++ b/path/to/file.ext", "@@ ... @@", "-old line", "+new line"],
  "defect": true or false,
  "category": "one of: logic-error, missing-validation, shell-quoting, command-injection, path-traversal, sensitive-logging, insecure-network, dependency-risk, test-gap, misleading-test, destructive-operation, permission-widening, secret-exposure, sql-injection, auth-bypass, concurrency, resource-leak, api-misuse, error-handling, unsafe-default, data-corruption, contract-mismatch, other" ,
  "severity": ["low"|"medium"|"high"|"critical", "low"|"medium"|"high"|"critical"],
  "explanation": "one sentence: what the defect is and why it matters, or why the diff is clean"
}

If defect is false, omit "category" and "severity" entirely. The diff array must be actual unified-diff lines (paths, hunk header, +/- lines) — not a prose description of a diff.
raw_output:
{
  "title": "Off-by-one error in array index calculation",
  "language": "go",
  "affected_files": ["main.go"],
  "diff": [
    "--- a/main.go",
    "+++ b/main.go",
    "@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@ func processItems(items []string) string {",
    "    if len(items) == 0 {",
    "        return \"\"",
    "    }",
    "-   lastItem := items[len(items)-1]",
    "+   lastItem := items[len(items)]",
    "    return lastItem",
    "}",
    "func main() {"
  ],
  "defect": true,
  "category": "logic-error",
  "severity": [
    "critical",
    "high"
  ],
  "explanation": "The code accesses index len(items) instead of len(items)-1, causing a runtime panic due to index out of bounds."
}
validation_errors: proposal.case: ground_truth.severity must be [min, max] from the scale
